name: camayoc_work_item_token_cost
description: verification-and-liveness Q16: what a work item cost, in tokens, summed over every usage record attributed to it — across every principal and session that touched it. An item with no attributed usage returns NO row: UNKNOWN, never zero.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?workItem (SUM(?tokens) AS ?totalTokens) WHERE { BIND(<{workitem}> AS ?workItem) ?record a aegis:UsageRecord ; aegis:attributedTo ?workItem ; aegis:tokensConsumed ?tokens . } GROUP BY ?workItem
